updates.title: New Built-in Entra Role: SOC Identity Responder
updates.summary: Microsoft introduced a new built-in role, SOC Identity Responder, enabling security teams to perform identity containment actions from Microsoft Defender without requiring multiple high-privilege roles. This least-privilege approach reduces delays during incident response and decreases dependency on identity administrators.

updates.title: External Users Can Be Directly Assigned to Access Packages
updates.summary: Entitlement Management now allows admins to directly assign external users not yet in the directory to access packages by email, automatically inviting them as guest users. This simplifies governance of external access without requiring pre-population of guest accounts.

updates.title: Entra Kerberos Key Rotation Improved for Incoming Trust Referral Flows
updates.summary: Enhanced Kerberos key rotation now handles both primary and secondary keys during validation, eliminating authentication failures in environments using incoming trust referral flows. This improves reliability during key rotation cycles without requiring manual intervention.

updates.title: BYOD Support for Windows Clients Using Entra Registration Now Generally Available
updates.summary: Windows BYOD support via Entra registration is now generally available, allowing users and partners to access corporate resources from personal devices with streamlined setup. Administrators can assign the Private Application traffic profile to internal and guest users without device pre-registration requirements.

updates.title: Jailbreak/Root Detection in Authenticator App Generally Available
updates.summary: Microsoft Authenticator now detects and blocks work or school accounts on rooted or jailbroken devices, forcing users to move to compliant devices to maintain access. This capability is enabled by default and strengthens endpoint security posture.

updates.title: Extended Conditional Access Protections for AI Agent User Accounts
updates.summary: Conditional Access now supports targeting and protecting AI agent accounts with precision, enabling admins to use custom security attributes for agent grouping, apply policies based on agent risk, and enforce compliance requirements. This closes a critical gap in securing autonomous AI identities.

updates.title: Domainless SAML IdP Federation for Workforce Tenants Generally Available
updates.summary: Domainless SAML federation now allows external users to authenticate using their IdP credentials without requiring email domain matching. This simplifies B2B authentication and removes friction from invitation redemption and sign-in flows.

updates.title: SCIM 2.0 APIs for Microsoft Entra ID Now Available in US Gov Cloud
updates.summary: SCIM 2.0 APIs for standards-based user and group management are now generally available in US Government cloud environments. This enables government agencies and their partners to use industry-standard provisioning protocols in compliance with federal cloud requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Now Generally Available
updates.summary: Entra Backup and Recovery is a built-in, always-on solution that automatically backs up critical directory objects including users, groups, apps, policies, and authentication settings to enable rapid recovery from accidental or malicious changes. This provides essential protection against data loss and configuration drift.

updates.title: Prevent Unauthorized Changes to AD Groups with AD Group Enforcement
updates.summary: A new preview capability lets admins designate specific Active Directory groups to accept changes only through Entra provisioning, blocking unauthorized modifications outside the provisioning service. This prevents group drift and maintains consistency between Entra and on-premises AD.

updates.title: Protect Sensitive Data with DLP Integration in Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enforcing restrictive actions and detecting risky activity. This prevents sensitive data leakage to untrusted cloud applications, generative AI platforms, and social media.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience in Preview
updates.summary: IRM now combines the Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts list with the ability to preview agent summaries and details directly on the page. This streamlines alert management and reduces context switching during investigations.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management User Profile Details Expanded with Entra Signals
updates.summary: IRM alerts now display expanded user profile details from Microsoft Entra, including office location, employee type, department, and last working date. This enriches investigator context during alert triage and risk assessment.

updates.title: DLP Prevents External Email Processing in Microsoft 365 Copilot
updates.summary: DLP policies now prevent Copilot from processing external emails, reducing prompt injection and data leakage risks from untrusted senders. This provides real-time control over Copilot's grounding data sources.

updates.title: File Quarantine Action in DLP for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: DLP file quarantine automatically moves sensitive files to an admin-controlled location when policies are triggered, instantly removing user access while preserving evidence. This provides immediate containment of data exposure risks.

updates.title: DLP and Auto-labeling Extended to Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP and auto-labeling now protect data in Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex with configurable conditions and actions per app. This expands data security coverage beyond Microsoft 365 to hybrid environments.

updates.title: Data Security Investigations Integration with Endpoint DLP Alerts
updates.summary: Data Security Investigations can now be launched from endpoint DLP alerts, automatically gathering related files that triggered alerts for faster analysis. This accelerates investigation of exfiltrated content by automating file collection.

updates.title: DLP Event Data Added to Defender Alerts Graph API
updates.summary: Graph API now enriched with DLP event data alongside alert data, enabling easier SIEM integration, automated workflows, and customizable reporting without manual API consolidation. This simplifies security infrastructure integration for customers.

updates.title: DLP Prevents Sensitive Data in External Web Searches from Copilot
updates.summary: DLP now blocks Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches, preventing accidental leakage of confidential information to the public internet. This provides real-time guardrails around AI-assisted search behavior.

updates.title: Auto-labeling Capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive Increased to 500,000 Files/Day
updates.summary: Maximum auto-labeling capacity increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, enabling organizations to label and protect more data at rest faster. This helps close labeling gaps and prepares data estates for Copilot with greater confidence.
